Final notebook to have the figure from the report


```{r include=FALSE}

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(arrow)
library(lubridate)
library(estimatr)
library(stargazer)

Sys.setenv(lang = "en_US")
```



```{r}
save_path_entsoe_output <- 'C:/Users/DBT3KD/Desktop/Etude_macro_elec/prix_electricite_gitlab/Intra_day_micro/outputs/final'
setwd(save_path_entsoe_output)

first_stage_data <- read_parquet('first_stage_data.parquet') %>% 
  rename(Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity = Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity,
         Published.Limiting.Unavailable.Capacity = Limiting.Unavailable.Capacity
         )

colnames_with_capacity <- colnames(first_stage_data)[grepl("Capacity", colnames(first_stage_data))]
#get monthly avg of unavailabilities
capacity_fields <- 
  c(colnames_with_capacity,
    "day_ahead_forecast",  "unpredicted_renewables", "intraday_update_renewables")

first_stage_data[colnames_with_capacity] <- lapply(first_stage_data[colnames_with_capacity], function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), 0, x))


#adjuster l'ordre de grandeur des indispos pour ne pas avoir des coefficients nuls
first_stage_data_clean <- first_stage_data%>%
  filter(is.finite(log_price_diff) & 
           is.finite(Published.Unavailable.Capacity))%>% 
   mutate(across(all_of(capacity_fields), 
                ~ . / 1000)) %>% 
  mutate(Published.Unavailable.Capacity = Published.Unavailable.Capacity - Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
         Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity = Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity - Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
         Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity = Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity - Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
         Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity = Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity - Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity
         )

# Créer une variable factorielle pour clusteriser
first_stage_data_clean <- first_stage_data_clean %>% 
  mutate(cluster_var = interaction(auction_date_plus_one, auction))

```


```{r}
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)

non_finite_rows <- first_stage_data %>%
  filter(!is.finite(log_price_diff) | !is.finite(Published.Unavailable.Capacity))
first_stage_data_clean$weekday <- weekdays(first_stage_data_clean$delivery_date) 

colnames(first_stage_data_clean)
```


Dernier test, on utilise les unavailabilities calculées par le modèle de random forest.
Et l'on compare avec l'indispo déclarée

```{r}

# perform first stage regression
m_real <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Published.Dismissed.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity + Unpublished.Dismissed.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity+ gen_tot+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month)+as.factor(weekday)+
    as.factor(creneau) + factor(auction_before),
  data= first_stage_data_clean)
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_real, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cluster_var)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_real <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))


m_real_all <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Published.Dismissed.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity + Unpublished.Dismissed.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity +
    Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity + Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity+
    + gen_tot+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month)+as.factor(weekday)+
    as.factor(creneau) + factor(auction_before),
  data= first_stage_data_clean)
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_real_all, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cluster_var)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_real_published <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))


# warning cannot put a dummy for date + creneau + auction
# full determination, no variation
m_dismissed <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity + Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity+
    Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity + Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity + gen_tot+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month) + as.factor(weekday) +
    as.factor(creneau) + factor(auction_before),
  data= first_stage_data_clean)


vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_dismissed, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cluster_var)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_dismissed <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée



# warning cannot put a dummy for date + creneau + auction
# full determination, no variation
m_all <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity + Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity+
    Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity + Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity+
    Published.Unavailable.Capacity + Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity+
    Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity + Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity + gen_tot+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month) + as.factor(weekday) +
    as.factor(creneau) + factor(auction_before),
  data= first_stage_data_clean)

vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_all, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cluster_var)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_all <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée





```



```{r, results = 'asis'}

reg_table <- stargazer(m_real, m_real_all, m_dismissed, m_all,
    type = "html",
    se = list(cl_se_real, cl_se_real_published, cl_se_dismissed, cl_se_all ),
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c("", "", "", ""),
    keep = c('Constant', 'Published.Unavailable.Capacity', "Limiting.Unavailable.Capacity",
             "Unpublished.Limiting.Unavailable.Capacity","Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity",
             'Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity', "Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity",'gen_tot',
             "Published.Dismissed.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity",'Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity',
             'Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity',
             "Unpublished.Dismissed.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity",
             "Published.Dismissed.Limiting.Unavailable.Capacity" , "Unpublished.Dismissed.Limiting.Unavailable.Capacity" ,
    "Published.Limiting.Unavailable.Capacity" ,"Unpublished.Limiting.Unavailable.Capacity",
    "Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity" , "Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity",
    "Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity" , "Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity",
    "Published.Unavailable.Capacity" , "Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity",
    "Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity" , "Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity"
    )
)
 
```






I use this additional variation to get a more precise estimate

```{r}
first_stage_data_clean_negative_variation <- first_stage_data_clean %>%
  mutate(Published.Tot.Unavailable.Capacity = Published.Unavailable.Capacity - Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity,
         Published.Tot.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity = Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity - Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
         Unpublished.Tot.Unavailable.Capacity = Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity - Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity,
         Unpublished.Tot.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity = Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity - Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
         Published.Tot.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity = Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity - Published.Dismissed.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity,
         Unpublished.Tot.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity = Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity - Unpublished.Dismissed.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity
         )


# warning cannot put a dummy for date + creneau + auction
# full determination, no variation
m_control_all <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Published.Tot.Unavailable.Capacity + Published.Tot.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity+
    Unpublished.Tot.Unavailable.Capacity + Unpublished.Tot.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity + gen_tot+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month) + as.factor(weekday) +
    as.factor(creneau) + factor(auction_before),
  data= first_stage_data_clean_negative_variation)

vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_control_all, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cluster_var)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_control_all <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))


# perform first stage regression
m_real <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Published.Tot.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity + Unpublished.Tot.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity+ gen_tot+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month)+ as.factor(weekday)+
    as.factor(creneau) + factor(auction_before),
  data= first_stage_data_clean_negative_variation)
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_real, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cluster_var)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_real <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))



```


```{r, results = 'asis'}
# Create LaTeX code with regression results
reg_table <- stargazer(m_real, m_control_all, 
    type = "html",
    se = list(cl_se_real, cl_se_control_all),
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c("Basic", "Timeslot FE", 'Timeslot + Auction FE'),
    keep = c('Constant', 'Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity', "Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity",
             'Published.Tot.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity' ,
             "Published.Tot.Unavailable.Capacity", "Published.Tot.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity", 
    "Unpublished.Tot.Unavailable.Capacity" , "Unpublished.Tot.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity","Unpublished.Tot.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity",'gen_tot')
 )
```
